exposure: Lung ultrasound aeration scoring (LUS Aeration Scores)
Gestational age at first trial off nCPAP
outcome: Successful weaning off nasal continuous positive airway pressure (nCPAP)
cohort: The study included 50 preterm neonates born at less than 33 weeks gestational age who required any respiratory pressure support after birth.
finding: A pre-trial off LUS Aeration Score of 8 or less was associated with a nine-fold increased odds of successful weaning off nCPAP, independent of birth gestational age and gestational age at nCPAP trial off, with each additional week of gestational age at first trial off also increasing the odds of cessation.
followup_time: At least 32 weeks corrected gestational age (mean 33.3 weeks corrected GA for successful group)
